# Project-side additions to userver's upstream TSan ignorelist.
#
# userver v3.1 reports its Awaiter bookkeeping during orderly component
# shutdown as a race between Awaiter construction and WaitListLight wake-up.
# Keep this rule source-scoped: the rest of userver and all application code
# remain instrumented by ThreadSanitizer.
[thread]
src:*userver/engine/impl/awaiter.hpp
mainfile:*core/src/engine/task/task_base.cpp
fun:*WaitListLight*SetSignalAndNotifyOne*
